system.description:
Represents a false persona — often claiming membership in another clan entirely — built up carefully over years or decades to withstand scrutiny. It reflects how well the cover story holds together and how much status or trust it can leverage, not the character's raw ability to act the part (that falls under Subterfuge). A character may take this Background multiple times to maintain multiple identities, each rated separately.

  • • A quick, thin cover. Fine for casual dealings, but any real investigation is likely to unravel it.
  • •• The identity holds up under most ordinary conditions, though a truly determined investigator will likely still succeed with effort.
  • ••• The identity is known and accepted in a few domains, with genuine name recognition there.
  • •••• The persona carries a strong reputation across several domains.
  • ••••• The identity is impeccable and respected as a genuine member of the claimed clan; even an elder or two would vouch for it if questioned.

Storyteller's Note: use a difficulty of 5 + this Background's rating for any extended investigation another character undertakes to expose the truth behind the cover identity. Establishing or maintaining a false identity often requires the quiet help of allies.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book One: Charlatans
